name: 极简墨青声波电动牙刷款
description: 极简黑白灰体系配墨青点缀的电动牙刷九屏转化套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshot and macro, airy light warm grey #E9E9E7 and #F4F4F2 panels for infographic and scene, deep jade-teal #2F6B5F reserved for the closing shot only
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft diffused studio light, front-left key with wide fill, gentle contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte pale stone counter #DCDCD8 and seamless matte paper panels
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif with generous letter-spacing
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single charcoal or jade-teal color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable upright slim-handle product presentation, consistent scale across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent minimalist personal-care visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, light warm grey #E9E9E7, charcoal text #2E2E2C and one deep jade-teal accent #2F6B5F; bright soft diffused studio lighting with front-left key and gentle contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif with generous letter-spacing; consistent thin-line icon style; clean minimalist product photography mixed with airy infographic panels; stable upright product presentation and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底主图
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, slim handle standing upright, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill, gentle contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The slim upright handle photographed straight-on at eye-level, full product visible, perfectly centered. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front key and soft fill, a gentle contact shadow grounding the product. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame. Generous clean margin around the silhouette, no extra whitespace objects. 8K, commercial personal-care e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no colored background tint, no cut-off handle edges, no floating product without contact shadow.

shots.intent: 一秒传达核心利益主张，承接首屏点击
shots.camera: slight 3/4 hero angle, product on the left third
shots.lighting: soft front-left key light, gentle contact shadow, subtle jade-teal rim accent
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the right 40% for the headline copy
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The slim upright product shown at a slight 3/4 hero angle on the left third, occupying 50-60% of the frame. Background light warm grey #E9E9E7, soft front-left key light with a subtle jade-teal rim accent and gentle contact shadow. One thin-line charcoal icon floats above the product. A clean headline in charcoal #2E2E2C reading 「{selling_point_1}」 sits in the right-side negative space. Negative: no more than one claim, no efficacy percentages, no invented test data, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the product, no second headline.

shots.intent: 放大手动刷牙够不到、刷不到位的日常摩擦点
shots.camera: matched split-screen framing, straight-on eye-level identical on both panels
shots.lighting: left panel flat and dull; right panel bright and airy with the same front-left key
shots.background: light warm panel #F4F4F2 on both sides
shots.props: left panel an ordinary manual toothbrush; right panel {product}
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, the two states fill the panels
shots.textZone: small caption strip under each panel
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched panels with identical straight-on eye-level camera and framing. Left panel: an ordinary manual toothbrush lying flat under dull flat light, with faint abstract shadow shapes suggesting hard-to-reach blind spots, no mouth or face shown. Right panel: {product} standing upright in bright airy light. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Background light warm #F4F4F2 on both panels. Short charcoal captions 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in small caption strips under each panel. The product occupies 40-50% per panel. Negative: no real model face or mouth, no fabricated before-after results, no efficacy statistics, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no messy clutter.

shots.intent: 代入真实晨间洗漱场景，营造清爽极简的生活方式
shots.camera: slight 3/4 eye-level, candid handheld feel over a bathroom counter
shots.lighting: soft morning window light from the left, 5500K, gentle mist, soft contact shadow
shots.background: matte pale stone bathroom counter #DCDCD8 with soft morning light
shots.props: a ribbed jade-teal ceramic rinsing cup #2F6B5F and a folded towel, not covering the product
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, the scene fills the frame naturally
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} standing in a ribbed jade-teal ceramic rinsing cup #2F6B5F on a matte pale stone bathroom counter #DCDCD8. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed at a slight 3/4 eye-level with a candid handheld feel. Soft morning window light from the left, 5500K, a hint of gentle mist, soft contact shadows. Props: the rinsing cup and a folded towel placed beside, not covering the product. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame. Negative: no visible face or recognizable person, no hands covering the product, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no cluttered countertop, no impossible shadows.

shots.intent: 用刷毛顶端的做工细节证明品质
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, shallow depth of field, foreground bristle tuft sharp
shots.lighting: skimming light from the right revealing bristle texture, controlled highlight
shots.whitespace: minimal, the macro detail is the whole subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of the brush head of {product}, tight zoom on the bristle tuft tips. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field with the foreground tuft razor sharp. Skimming light from the right revealing the fine bristle texture with a controlled highlight. Neutral matte board background #F4F4F2. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame. Minimal margin, no extra whitespace elements. Negative: no blurry subject, no splayed or melted-looking bristles, no invented bristle material claims, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no props.

shots.intent: 以刷毛形态的整齐差异直观呈现做工差距
shots.camera: two matched macro panels, 90-degree side profile on both sides, identical crop
shots.lighting: identical skimming light from the right on both panels for a fair visual delta
shots.props: left panel a worn generic bristle tuft; right panel the bristle tuft of {product}
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, matched panels fill the frame
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce comparison layout, two matched macro panels photographed from a 90-degree side profile with identical crop and lighting. Left panel: a worn, splayed generic bristle tuft under the same skimming light. Right panel: the neat, evenly aligned bristle tuft of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Clean white background #FFFFFF on both panels, identical skimming light from the right. The detail fills 55-60% per panel. No captions, the visual delta reads on its own. Negative: no fabricated test data or percentages, no invented certification marks, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no misaligned framing between panels.

shots.intent: 以结构化信息框架交代档位与参数，留空待填真实数据
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down at the product lying on the panel
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow, fully readable
shots.background: airy light warm grey #E9E9E7 infographic panel
shots.props: thin charcoal parameter lines and four empty label rows waiting for copy
shots.whitespace: structured negative space on the right 40% for the spec list
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic spec screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The slim product lying diagonally, photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down, occupying 45-50% of the frame. Background airy light warm grey #E9E9E7, even high-key flat lighting. On the right, a structured spec list of four clean label rows in charcoal #2E2E2C with short headings 「{callout_3}」 「{callout_4}」 「{callout_5}」 「{callout_6}」 and deliberately blank value lines to be filled in post. One thin jade-teal divider line. Negative: no fabricated numbers, speeds, rates or durations, no invented certifications, no dense body text, no tiny unreadable text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 平铺展示包装内全部物品，降低选购疑虑
shots.camera: flat lay, top-down 90-degree overhead angle, all items fully visible
shots.lighting: even high-key studio light, soft contact shadows under each item
shots.props: the product, two spare brush heads and a charging cable arranged in a tidy grid
shots.whitespace: even gutters between items, no extra decorative whitespace
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce what-is-in-the-box flat lay of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a top-down 90-degree overhead angle, the product, two spare brush heads and a charging cable arranged in a tidy grid, all fully visible with even gutters. Even high-key studio light with soft contact shadows under each item. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The group occupies 60-70% of the frame overall. Negative: no invented certifications or award badges, no fake QR code, no membership or promo stickers, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no items cut off at the frame edge.

shots.intent: 深色收口促单，以行动按钮完成转化闭环
shots.camera: slight 3/4 hero angle, product centered and upright
shots.lighting: soft diffused studio light with a brighter rim to lift the silhouette off the dark field
shots.props: one rounded light button element below the product
shots.whitespace: generous dark negative space above the product for the closing copy
shots.textZone: top headline zone plus button label
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce promo close of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The upright product centered at a slight 3/4 hero angle on a deep jade-teal #2F6B5F seamless field, occupying 55-60% of the frame. Soft diffused studio light with a brighter rim lifting the silhouette off the dark background, gentle contact shadow. A rounded light-toned button element below the product carrying the short label 「{callout_7}」, and a white headline in the upper negative space reading 「{selling_point_2}」. Negative: no invented discounts or countdown timers, no fabricated claims, no fake QR code, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no cluttered promo bursts.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：P1 浅灰白底上手动牙刷插在青绿罗纹漱口杯（黄色杯底），上方为品牌字母字与「轻颜极简」等字样；P2 深灰卡片阵列标注「5中刷牙模式」（疑为5种之错字）；P3 极简文案与「高能校磁悬浮马达」；P4 「约30000次/分钟高频率震动」「5档模式」；P5 五行档位列表全部同名「清洁模式 有效清洁口腔」；P6 「30S换区提醒」与「进口冲击软刷毛 温柔呵护」；P7 空白灰图位加重复软毛文案；P8 产品参数表但各值均为「千小图电动牙刷11」占位、无真实参数；P9 「加入会员 全店免费」二维码角标。品类判定：源夹名「洗护」与品类无关；依 P8 参数区品名「电动牙刷」及 P4/P5 声波震动、档位文案，判定为个护口腔用品，最贴切 taxonomy 类目为 护肤个护/口腔护理（声波电动牙刷）。已剥离：品牌字与「轻颜极简」字样、会员二维码角标、原文案原句、马达与每分钟震动次数、30秒换区时长、模式数量、刷毛产地与软毛呵护等功效断言；P5 五档全部同名「清洁模式」属源页自相矛盾，档位数量与名称均未写入，仅以 {callout} 留空参数行承接；P1 手动牙刷画面与 P4-P8 电动牙刷主体矛盾，两种形态均不作事实，场景杯具仅作道具语言。产品一律 {product} 占位，人像未出现、无可辨识面容。
